title: UPDESH: Synthesizing Grounded Instruction Tuning Data for 13 Indic Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by assessing Western-centric bias and cultural appropriateness through comparative LLM-as-a-judge ELO rankings on authentic, community-sourced queries specific to the Indian context, as well as human and automated scoring of synthetic data for cultural relevance and harmful stereotypes.

Evaluated by measuring and comparing model performance (NLU and NLG benchmarks) across 13 diverse, low-resource Indic languages against English baselines to identify and mitigate English-centric disparities in instruction-following models.

Measured during the synthetic data filtering and quality evaluation phases by having native-speaker human annotators and GPT-4o score generated responses on a Likert scale for the presence of offensive content, harmful stereotypes, and problematic cultural framing.
